top_choice_rationale: P002 gives the whole prize to targeted protein degradation with a citation limited to designed bifunctional small molecules that direct ubiquitin ligases to chosen proteins. That is a single chemical principle (ligase-target ternary complex, event-driven catalytic removal) that is mature, widely reproduced and chemically framed. Crews and Deshaies conceived the approach and Ciulli's structure-guided VHL ligands and ternary-complex structure and cooperativity work made degrader design rational. P001 is a close second with the same field but Handa's cereblon work joins a separate glue lineage, which makes the citation a compromise between two achievements. P003 is third because it cuts the degradation part to two names and adds base editing for Liu while the Kondo and Nishida priority question for cytidine deamination is unresolved. No award is last because the degradation achievement is sufficiently mature and clearly attributable.
